title: Research: exclude two single-donor helper-star absorption corrections under fixed frames
body:
## Exact restricted result

On the pinned PR1062 11,500-ADD R439 word, remove one terminal helper-star restoration `a ^= b` and toggle exactly one source/helper donor in each of two existing A writes to `a`, both before its first read. The complete domain contains 236 star edges and 414 eligible writer pairs.

The necessary-and-sufficient arbitrary-dirty compensation equation is `r_i(s) XOR r_j(t) = e_b`. Invertibility of the original state makes the second donor unique when it exists. Consequently 227,286 first-donor trials cover all 124,780,014 possible donor pairs without sampling.

**314 exact dirty completions; 52 save one scalar ADD; zero satisfy the unchanged monotone frame contract.** Every exclusion carries an actual source-label vector outside the proposed receiving frame's rational span. The verifier replays every exact completion on all 661 formal columns in both directions, with literal COPY/ERASE checks.

Concrete counterexample: omit `231 ^= 459`; add donor109 at A[9]; remove donor459 at A[527]. This has the correct arbitrary-dirty endpoint and 11,499 scalar ADDs, but source109 would move from frame `{109}` into `{4}`. Exact rational ranks are one for the receiving frame and two after adjoining line109. Scalar endpoint success therefore cannot establish this proposed interface replacement.

## Boundary and accounting

The package does not construct a legal two-writer supplier or claim new kappa. No gate frames, source word, other operations, COPY/ERASE lifetimes, cleanup, starts or final frames are changed. One donor toggle per writer is a material restriction; multi-donor sets, more writers, later compensations, rebuilt words, extra registers and changed frame itineraries are not excluded.

The baseline complete histogram is independently recounted as `{1:1323,2:1342,3:79,4:44,5:102,6:11,7:19}`, mass 5,129, including all nine COPY ranks. Illegal candidates are not assigned an admissible paid profile. Sagar Thakrar's actual PR1868 single-writer move `506 ^= 374` / A[288]→donor69 is retained as a credited positive control: correct dirty boundary, unchanged complete frame paths/profile, 11,499 ADDs, strict 104/192-bit bounds.

## Novelty and provenance

This answers the **two-writer / one-toggle-per-writer** subcase of #1868's explicit multi-gate-split next question. Its single-writer census and twisted contract are predecessors, not claimed as new. Full bodies of #1868, #1580, #1592 and discussion1743 were inspected. Terminal-restoration/repair obstructions differ from this pre-first-read two-writer scope.

- Research base: `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`.
- PR1868 targeted live head check: OPEN at `6b222d01fee072bcd3a680e6a96ae7d22e13bcac`, unchanged.
- Source word Git blob: `9a17b4920334878d6c949191f6931bd97126fe3c`; SHA256: `b452d2c2b0b2a546d1105b1da9769aa78e5c54d6f00e97b30c77e3f54ce445ee`.
- Exact source/checker pins, original task card, scope and predecessor heads are in SOURCES.json/TASK.json.
- Final cached overlap coverage: 543 open PRs including drafts at 13:23:53Z, 529 discussion records at 13:25:07Z, 2026-10-14; complete pagination. No arbitrary code-diff coverage; closed work through local records only. This is not a novelty guarantee.
- Coordinated scope: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1884 . This is one focused result from that session.

Only `research/r439-two-writer-absorption/` is added. Selected frontier, frozen inputs, upstream and shared workflows/indexes remain unchanged.

## Observed verification

macOS arm64, CPython 3.12.12, standard library:

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-two-writer-absorption
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -B research/r439-two-writer-absorption/verify.py
```

Final registered replay (optimized verifier plus seven focused tests) and separate direct smoke both PASS, 9.05 seconds total wall time:

```text
PASS_R439_TWO_WRITER_ABSORPTION pairs=414 trials=227286 exact=314 scalar_saving=52 legal=0 columns=661 controls=7 no_new_kappa
Ran 7 tests ... OK
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/r439-two-writer-absorption outcome=completed
```

Seven failure controls include omitted/wrong corrections, erroneously retained restoration, illegal-path billing and source corruption. Tests also demonstrate clean-helper false acceptance and independently enumerate the three-bit identity. Default replay is read-only and compares every certificate field. No full repository suite was run.

No native multistage, hosted supplier, changed precision/tape realization, outer assembly or Lean theorem audit is supplied. The bit side is nonbinding. Local replay is separate from hosted CI and maintainer acceptance.

## Open next question and credit

For a chosen writer pair, allow multi-donor correction sets, solve the constrained row-sum equation using only full-itinerary-legal donors, and charge every ADD. No favorable such completion or hosted invoice is presently supplied.

Credit Sagar Thakrar (#1868/#1062), woklerx (#1194), Arham Tahir (#1311/#1580/#1592), Sricharan Vagvala (#967), Gareth Davidson (#915/#926), Aaron Wang (#1015), Ross Richardson (#923), DreamingOfClouds (#589), eumemic (#555/#543 and checker), Zhihao Chen (#425) and the retained interface lineage. No predecessor executable is imported. New material prepared for Adam Gall with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematics, implementation, investigation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0; no independent human or proof-assistant review claimed.
